# PhysioECG ![PhysioECG logo](reference/figures/logo.png)

**ECG Analysis Functions for PhysioExperiment Objects**

PhysioECG provides electrocardiography (ECG) analysis functions for the
PhysioExperiment ecosystem. With 18 exported functions, it delivers a
complete ECG analysis pipeline – from R-peak detection using an adaptive
Pan-Tompkins algorithm, through RR interval computation and ectopic beat
correction, to comprehensive heart rate variability (HRV) analysis
across time-domain, frequency-domain, and nonlinear methods. It also
includes ECG morphology analysis (PQRST waveform delineation, clinical
interval measurement) and signal quality assessment.

## Installation

You can install PhysioECG from
[r-universe](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev):

``` r

install.packages("PhysioECG",
  repos = c("https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

Or install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("x-biosignal/PhysioECG")
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(PhysioECG)

# Generate a simulated ECG signal (10 seconds at 500 Hz, 72 bpm)
pe <- make_ecg(n_time = 5000, sr = 500, heart_rate = 72)

# Detect R-peaks using the adaptive Pan-Tompkins algorithm
peaks <- ecgDetectRpeaks(pe)
head(peaks)
#>   channel sample time_sec amplitude
#> 1       1    347    0.692      1.50
#> 2       1    764    1.526      1.50
#> ...

# Compute RR intervals
rr <- ecgRRintervals(pe, peaks)

# Time-domain HRV metrics
hrv_time <- ecgHRVtime(rr)
hrv_time
#>   channel mean_rr   sdnn rmssd pnn50 mean_hr
#> 1       1  833.33   1.23  0.87     0   72.00

# Frequency-domain HRV analysis (Welch PSD)
hrv_freq <- ecgHRVfreq(rr, method = "welch")

# Nonlinear HRV (Poincare, Sample Entropy, DFA)
hrv_nl <- ecgHRVnonlinear(rr)

# ECG morphology: delineate P, QRS, T waves
delin <- ecgDelineate(pe, peaks)
intervals <- ecgIntervals(delin, sr = 500)
head(intervals)
#>   channel beat  pr_ms  qt_ms  qtc_ms qrs_ms  rr_ms
#> 1       1    1  126.0  360.0   394.1   80.0  833.3
```

## Features

### R-Peak Detection

Adaptive dual-threshold Pan-Tompkins detector with automatic
inverted-signal handling:

- [`ecgDetectRpeaks()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDetectRpeaks.md)
  – detect R-peaks using bandpass filtering (5–15 Hz), differentiation,
  squaring, moving-window integration, and adaptive thresholding

### RR Interval Analysis

RR interval computation and ectopic beat correction:

- [`ecgRRintervals()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgRRintervals.md)
  – compute RR intervals from detected R-peaks
- [`ecgQualityCheck()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgQualityCheck.md)
  – detect ectopic beats using local median comparison
- [`ecgRRcorrect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgRRcorrect.md)
  – correct ectopic beats by interpolation or removal

### HRV Time-Domain Analysis

Standard time-domain HRV metrics per ESC/NASPE Task Force guidelines:

- [`ecgHRVtime()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVtime.md)
  – SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, mean RR, mean heart rate

### HRV Frequency-Domain Analysis

Power spectral density estimation with standard frequency band
integration:

- [`ecgHRVfreq()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVfreq.md)
  – VLF (0.003–0.04 Hz), LF (0.04–0.15 Hz), HF (0.15–0.4 Hz) power,
  LF/HF ratio, total power
- Supports Welch’s method (resampled FFT) and Lomb-Scargle periodogram

### HRV Nonlinear Analysis

Nonlinear dynamics and complexity measures:

- [`ecgHRVnonlinear()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVnonlinear.md)
  – convenience wrapper combining all nonlinear metrics
- [`ecgHRVpoincare()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVpoincare.md)
  – Poincare plot descriptors (SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 ratio)
- [`ecgSampleEntropy()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgSampleEntropy.md)
  – sample entropy for signal complexity/regularity
- [`ecgDFA()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDFA.md)
  – detrended fluctuation analysis (alpha1 short-range, alpha2
  long-range)

### ECG Morphology Analysis

Waveform delineation and clinical interval measurement:

- [`ecgDelineate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDelineate.md)
  – identify QRS complex boundaries, P-wave and T-wave peaks, and T-wave
  end for each beat
- [`ecgIntervals()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgIntervals.md)
  – compute PR interval, QRS duration, QT interval, and QTc (Bazett
  correction)

### Signal Quality Assessment

Signal quality evaluation and baseline correction:

- [`ecgSignalQuality()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgSignalQuality.md)
  – per-channel SNR, baseline wander, saturation ratio, and composite
  quality score
- [`ecgBaselineCorrect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgBaselineCorrect.md)
  – remove baseline wander using highpass moving-average or
  running-median subtraction

### Simulated ECG Data

Synthetic ECG generators for testing and demonstration:

- [`make_ecg()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg.md)
  – regular ECG with Gaussian-shaped R-peaks at fixed heart rate
- [`make_ecg_pqrst()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg_pqrst.md)
  – realistic PQRST morphology with known fiducial points for validation
- [`make_ecg_irregular()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg_irregular.md)
  – ECG with simulated ectopic (premature) beats and compensatory pauses
- [`make_ecg_noisy()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg_noisy.md)
  – ECG contaminated with baseline wander, powerline interference, and
  broadband noise

## Dependencies

- **R** (\>= 4.2)
- **[PhysioCore](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioCore)**
- **SummarizedExperiment**
- **S4Vectors**
- **stats**

## PhysioExperiment Ecosystem

PhysioECG is the ECG analysis module of the PhysioExperiment ecosystem,
a suite of R packages for multi-modal physiological signal analysis:

| Package | Description |
|----|----|
| [PhysioCore](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioCore) | Core data structures and accessors |
| [PhysioIO](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioIO) | File I/O (EDF, HDF5, BIDS, CSV, MAT) |
| [PhysioPreprocess](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioPreprocess) | Preprocessing (filters, ICA, resampling) |
| [PhysioAnalysis](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioAnalysis) | Analysis and visualization |
| **PhysioECG** | ECG analysis and HRV |
| [PhysioEDA](https://github.com/x-biosignal/PhysioEDA) | Electrodermal activity analysis |

Visit the [r-universe page](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev) to
browse all available packages.

## References

- Pan, J. & Tompkins, W.J. (1985). “A real-time QRS detection
  algorithm.” *IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering*, 32(3),
  230–236.
- Task Force of the ESC and NASPE (1996). “Heart rate variability:
  Standards of measurement, physiological interpretation and clinical
  use.” *Circulation*, 93(5), 1043–1065.
- Shaffer, F. & Ginsberg, J.P. (2017). “An overview of heart rate
  variability metrics and norms.” *Frontiers in Public Health*, 5, 258.
- Richman, J.S. & Moorman, J.R. (2000). “Physiological time-series
  analysis using approximate entropy and sample entropy.” *American
  Journal of Physiology*, 278(6), H2039–H2049.
- Peng, C.-K., et al. (1994). “Mosaic organization of DNA nucleotides.”
  *Physical Review E*, 49(2), 1685–1689.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`breathingRate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/breathingRate.md)
  : Estimate breathing rate
- [`dfaThresholdCrossings()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/dfaThresholdCrossings.md)
  : Detect DFA-a1 threshold crossings
- [`ecgAnalyze()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgAnalyze.md)
  : Aggregate ECG HRV and Morphology Metrics
- [`ecgBaselineCorrect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgBaselineCorrect.md)
  : Correct Baseline Wander in ECG Signals
- [`ecgBeatSQI()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgBeatSQI.md)
  : Beat-level Signal Quality Index (bSQI)
- [`ecgBeatSQIgate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgBeatSQIgate.md)
  : Accept/reject ECG channels by bSQI
- [`ecgDFA()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDFA.md)
  : Detrended Fluctuation Analysis of RR Intervals
- [`ecgDFArolling()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDFArolling.md)
  : Rolling (time-resolved) DFA alpha1
- [`ecgDelineate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDelineate.md)
  : Delineate ECG Waveform Morphology
- [`ecgDetectAF()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDetectAF.md)
  : Detect Atrial Fibrillation / Frequent Ectopy from RR Irregularity
- [`ecgDetectPVC()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDetectPVC.md)
  : Detect Premature Ventricular Contractions (PVCs)
- [`ecgDetectRpeaks()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgDetectRpeaks.md)
  : Detect R-Peaks in ECG Signal
- [`ecgEDR()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgEDR.md)
  : ECG-Derived Respiration (EDR)
- [`ecgEctopicBurden()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgEctopicBurden.md)
  : Ectopic Beat Burden
- [`ecgHRR()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRR.md)
  : Heart-Rate Recovery (HRR)
- [`ecgHRT()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRT.md)
  : Heart-Rate Turbulence (HRT)
- [`ecgHRVasymmetry()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVasymmetry.md)
  : Heart-Rate Asymmetry (Poincare Plot Asymmetry) Descriptors
- [`ecgHRVfreq()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVfreq.md)
  : HRV Frequency-Domain Analysis
- [`ecgHRVgeometric()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVgeometric.md)
  : Geometric HRV indices (triangular index and TINN)
- [`ecgHRVnonlinear()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVnonlinear.md)
  : Nonlinear HRV Analysis (Convenience Wrapper)
- [`ecgHRVpoincare()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVpoincare.md)
  : Poincare Plot Descriptors for HRV Analysis
- [`ecgHRVsegmented()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVsegmented.md)
  : Segmented (long-term) HRV indices: SDANN and SDNN index
- [`ecgHRVtime()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVtime.md)
  : HRV Time-Domain Metrics
- [`ecgHRVtimevarying()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgHRVtimevarying.md)
  : Time-Varying HRV (Sliding-Window Time and Frequency Metrics)
- [`ecgIntervals()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgIntervals.md)
  : Compute ECG Intervals from Delineation
- [`ecgPRSA()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgPRSA.md)
  : Phase-Rectified Signal Averaging (PRSA): DC and AC
- [`ecgProcess()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgProcess.md)
  : One-Call ECG Processing Pipeline
- [`ecgQualityCheck()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgQualityCheck.md)
  : Detect Ectopic Beats in RR Interval Data
- [`ecgRRcorrect()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgRRcorrect.md)
  : Correct Ectopic Beats in RR Interval Data
- [`ecgRRintervals()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgRRintervals.md)
  : Compute RR Intervals from Detected R-Peaks
- [`ecgRSA()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgRSA.md)
  : Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA)
- [`ecgSampleEntropy()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgSampleEntropy.md)
  : Sample Entropy of RR Intervals
- [`ecgSignalQuality()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ecgSignalQuality.md)
  : Assess ECG Signal Quality Per Channel
- [`make_ecg()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg.md)
  : Create Simulated ECG PhysioExperiment
- [`make_ecg_irregular()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg_irregular.md)
  : Create Simulated ECG with Irregular R-R Intervals
- [`make_ecg_noisy()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg_noisy.md)
  : Create Simulated ECG with Noise Artifacts
- [`make_ecg_pqrst()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ecg_pqrst.md)
  : Create Simulated ECG with PQRST Morphology
- [`make_ppg()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/make_ppg.md)
  : Simulate PPG with known fiducials
- [`perfusionIndex()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/perfusionIndex.md)
  : Calculate the PPG perfusion index
- [`plotEcgWave()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/plotEcgWave.md)
  : Plot Annotated ECG Waveform
- [`plotHRVpsd()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/plotHRVpsd.md)
  : Plot HRV Power Spectral Density with Frequency Bands
- [`plotPoincare()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/plotPoincare.md)
  : Plot Poincare (Lorenz) Recurrence Map
- [`plotTachogram()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/plotTachogram.md)
  : Plot RR Tachogram
- [`ppgDetectPulses()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ppgDetectPulses.md)
  : Detect systolic peaks in PPG
- [`ppgQuality()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ppgQuality.md)
  : Assess PPG signal quality
- [`ppgRespiration()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ppgRespiration.md)
  : Estimate respiration from PPG modulation
- [`pulseRateVariability()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/pulseRateVariability.md)
  : Calculate pulse-rate variability
- [`pulseWaveFeatures()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/pulseWaveFeatures.md)
  : Extract PPG pulse-wave features
- [`respiratoryOnsets()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/respiratoryOnsets.md)
  : Detect respiratory cycle onsets
- [`ripCalibrate()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ripCalibrate.md)
  : Calibrate two-belt respiratory inductance plethysmography
- [`smoothnessPriorsDetrend()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/smoothnessPriorsDetrend.md)
  : Smoothness-priors detrending
- [`tidalMetrics()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/tidalMetrics.md)
  : Calculate tidal breathing metrics
- [`ventilatoryThreshold()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioECG/reference/ventilatoryThreshold.md)
  : Detect ventilatory thresholds from incremental exercise data
